label: AI & Data
cardNote: 🧪 From a useful question to a result you can measure
headline: Start with the data and a useful question,
then test whether the model actually helps.
summary: In AI and data projects, I first decide what should improve and how to measure it. Then I work through the data, model, and experiments, and turn the result into something that can be used and checked in a real tool or service.

freelance: Used Python to explore data, test models, automate work, build inference APIs, and turn notebooks into testable modules.
Added AI features to applications with clear inputs and failure behavior, while keeping the result open to user review.
security: My security background helps me pay attention to data leakage, unsafe input, risky dependencies, and unexpected model behavior.
I build repeatable examples for failures instead of treating one unusually good or bad model output as a conclusion.
company: Worked on mobile and web applications, backend services, and NoSQL databases—the surrounding pieces needed to put a model into a real product.
Shared responsibility for design, error logging, and delivery, and learned to keep data-driven features in step with the rest of the application.
